relationships.subject: L-arginine
relationships.evidence_quote: Administration of NO precursor reversed the pronociceptive effect of the CB1 agonist on r-SIA.

relationships.subject: SIN-1
relationships.evidence_quote: Administration of an NO donor, instead, increased r-SIA.

relationships.subject: AM251
relationships.evidence_quote: Both the CB1 antagonist and the NOS inhibitor neutralized the pro-analgesic effect of L-arg.

relationships.subject: anandamide
relationships.evidence_quote: AEA administration immediately at the end of stress decreased the r-SIA.

key_findings: In rats after 1 h restraint, endocannabinoid CB1 signaling and the nitric oxide system interact in modulating stress-induced analgesia.
Findings suggest NO acts as a second messenger of the ECS.
